opinions.text:
Appeal from the Supreme Court of Missouri.

Per Curiam:

The judgment is affirmed. East Ohio Gas Co. v. Tax Commissioner, 283 U. S. 465, 470, 471; Southern Gas Corp. v. *643Alabama, 301 U. S. 148, 164.

Mr. H. P. Robinson, with whom Messrs. Rayburn L. Foster and R. H. Hudson were on the brief, for appellant. Messrs. Charles M. Howell, Jr., and Harry G. Waltner, Jr., for appellee. Mr. Justice Roberts took no part in the consideration and decision of this case.
